from datetime import datetime, timedelta

# Use phone API current date/time already fetched earlier via apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time
cur_dt = apis.phone.get_current_date_and_time()
print('cur_dt', cur_dt)
# Parse date string like 'Saturday, May 20, 2023'
import re
m = re.search(r"\w+,\s+(\w+)\s+(\d{1,2}),\s+(\d{4})", cur_dt['date'])
print('match', m)
month_name = m.group(1)
day = int(m.group(2))
year = int(m.group(3))
import calendar
month_num = list(calendar.month_name).index(month_name)
now_date = datetime(year, month_num, day).date()
yesterday_date = now_date - timedelta(days=1)
print('now_date', now_date, 'yesterday_date', yesterday_date)

# Parse shares from the previously loaded note (3084) if available; otherwise fetch.
content = None
if 'note' in globals() and isinstance(note, dict) and 'content' in note:
    content = note['content']
    parsed_from = f"note_id={note.get('note_id')}"
else:
    # fallback
    fallback_note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=sn_token)
    content = fallback_note['content']
    parsed_from = f"note_id={fallback_note.get('note_id')}"

print('parsed_from', parsed_from)
print('content\n', content)

import re
share_lines = re.findall(r"^-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$", content, flags=re.M)
shares = {}
for name, amt in share_lines:
    shares[name.strip()] = float(amt)

print('shares_parsed_count', len(shares))
print('shares', shares)
